import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'date': ['2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01'],
    'time': ['00:00', '02:00', '04:00', '06:00', '08:00'],
    'product': ['Cappuccino', 'Cappuccino', 'Tea', 'Latte', 'Americano'],
    'size': ['Large', 'Medium', 'Small', 'Large', 'Medium'],
    'price': [4.18, 4.01, 5.22, 6.37, 7.07],
    'quantity': [2, 3, 1, 2, 3],
    'payment_method': ['Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Cash'],
    'customer_age_group': ['55+', '35-44', '18-24', '45-54', '45-54'],
    'is_takeaway': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    'total': [8.36, 12.03, 5.22, 12.74, 21.21]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create datetime column for time series analysis
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sales by Product (Bar chart)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax1.bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(product_sales)))
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
             f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 2. Sales Over Time (Line chart)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
time_sales = df.groupby('datetime')['total'].sum()
ax2.plot(time_sales.index, time_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8)
ax2.set_title('Sales Over Time', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Time', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Sales by Age Group (Bar chart)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
age_order = ['18-24', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
bars = ax3.bar(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(age_sales)))
ax3.set_title('Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
             f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 4. Payment Method Distribution (Pie chart)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                   startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette("husl", len(payment_counts)))
ax4.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Product Size Distribution (Bar chart)
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
size_counts = df['size'].value_counts()
bars = ax5.bar(size_counts.index, size_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(size_counts)))
ax5.set_title('Product Size Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.1,
             str(int(height)), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 6. Price vs Quantity Scatter (colored by product)
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
products = df['product'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(products))
for product, color in zip(products, colors):
    product_data = df[df['product'] == product]
    ax6.scatter(product_data['price'], product_data['quantity'], 
                s=100, alpha=0.7, color=color, label=product, edgecolors='black')
ax6.set_title('Price vs Quantity (by Product)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Price ($)', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Quantity', fontsize=12)
ax6.legend(title='Product')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis - January 1, 2024', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
